criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and whose purpose matches its list of input purposes (name, email, address and so on). This field is a budget form value (budget name, spend limit amount, description or spend-control mode), so no listed purpose applies and the invalid token blocks no autofill the user needs. 4.1.2 is unaffected: the accessibility tree still exposes the field's role, name and state (see the ax probes). 1.3.1 and 3.3.2 are met because the visible label is programmatically associated. The invalid token is an HTML conformance error, and 4.1.1 Parsing no longer exists in WCAG 2.2.
